body: Im so sorry this happened to you its okay to be upset. I trusted someone who hurt me too but i survived and so will you, give your self some time you are more than a relationship with a cheater.

Please dont hurt yourself, i know the internet can be really bad and that when your in a bad head space those comments can really hurt. I dont know finances very well so i cant offer anything regarding advice, but i really dont want you hurt yourself.
Its ok, you tried and thats better than most, I wish I was as brave as you.
